senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; דון)judge, generally at the same time lecturer, spiritual leader.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 10a:5">Sabb. 10ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>דַּיָּינִים</he>, <he>דַּיָּינִין</he>. Snh. l. c. <he>כלי הד׳</he> the judges’ implements (stick, strap &c.).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 51a:1">B. Bath. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>דַּיָּינֵי גולה</he> the judges of the Diaspora (Karna a. Samuel; v.
Keth. XIII, 1, v. גְּזֵירָה; a. fr.—Fem. pl. דַּיָּינוֹת.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 2:8">Koh. R. to II, 8</cite> <he>דיינים זכרים וד׳ נקבות</he> male judges and female judges (leaders; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 968:1">Yalk. ib. 968</cite> <he>דַּיָּנִין … ודַּיָּנִין נקבות</he>).
